blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Panfilo “Ping” Lacson on Saturday said information revealed by former Sen. Antonio Trillanes IV in connection with Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment case has “no probative value.” Trillanes on Friday held a press conference at which he revealed the contents of his testimony that was supposed to be presented to the Senate impeachment court. This came after the House prosecution team announced that it would no longer present Trillanes as a witness on the alleged unexplained wealth charges against the vice president.
